name: Marcin Nowakowski
abstract_title: The Internal Observer: A New Frontier for Quantum AI and Self-Aware Systems
abstract: The science of consciousness stands at a crossroads, where the intersection of quantum physics, artificial intelligence, and cognitive science opens pathways toward deeper understanding. This talk presents the Internal Observer (IO) Theory [1-2] that synthesizes contemporary advances in quantum physics and artificial general intelligence to address the foundational role of the observer in both physical reality, AI and conscious experience.
